name: Orc_Rogue_Guild_Hex_V1
origin: center of footprint on ground Z=0
scale: Native 4X map units; pointy-top tile radius 1, military foundation radius .92; placement scale tile_radius. Asset only, no integration.
design: Original orc rogue guild: asymmetric dark timber and basalt rear hall with rust-red stepped hood roof matching the orc building family, short ivory ridge tusks and rust-red bindings; prominent silver hood, narrow eyes, little tusks and crossed short daggers on clan-red plaque. Low attached storehouse with dark red roof and canvas awning, ragged red awning valance, blade bench and stoppered preparation bottles. Open precision training yard with one straw marked-throat/heart dummy and one knife-throwing board, separate closed cellar hatch and moss shrubs. Same regular rogue/saboteur/assassin line; legendary shadow master belongs to separate mastery building. No character dependency, watchtower or perimeter wall ring.
notes: Studio and scale reference excluded from export. Separate editable source parts; consolidated game meshes by architectural group.
faction_tint: Crest backing cloth and ragged awning valance isolated in Faction mesh for future owner tint. No runtime integration.
